prompt:
A single vertical Twitch channel "About" panel graphic, full bleed, for a fantasy MMO and anime RPG gaming channel. Look: premium game UI like a high-end modern anime action RPG or MMO menu, painterly and richly detailed, NOT flat vector. Mood: a cozy adventurers' guild tavern — warm, welcoming and lively, like "come in, sit down, we are about to start". Warm lantern and hearth light, polished dark wood, brass fittings, leather, maps. NOT gloomy, NOT gothic, NOT horror, no skulls, no darkness-heavy shadows. Frame: carved warm walnut wood with polished brass/gold corner fittings and small amber gems around the whole panel. Inside: a rich warm dark-brown wood or leather background (#2a1a10 to #1a100a) softly lit in amber, so light text stays very readable. Palette: honey gold (#f5c542), warm amber, candle orange, wine red accents, warm browns; a small touch of teal for contrast. Mature anime RPG art, not cute, not chibi, not cartoonish, not childish, no stickers. TYPOGRAPHY IS CRITICAL: render every text string EXACTLY as written below, in Spanish, letter by letter, with its accents, punctuation and the leading exclamation mark on commands. Crisp, perfectly legible, evenly spaced. Do not add, translate, abbreviate or invent any other text, numbers, logos or watermarks.

HEADER (only the top ~15% of the panel, a short wide strip): a painted scene of the tavern's merchant counter — stacks and spilled piles of shining gold coins, a small brass scale, a coin purse, warm lanterns; it blends softly into the panel. Right under the header, centered: the title "RECOMPENSAS" in a large carved gold serif (Cinzel-like) with a soft warm glow, and under it a smaller cream line "Con Oros, los puntos del canal". Then a vertical list of 6 rows. Each row is a wide rounded plate with a colored left edge and soft glow in its rarity color, containing: on the left a small painted game-item icon, in the middle a bold title in bright cream-white with a smaller description line under it in warm light beige, and on the right the price in large bold gold digits next to a small gold coin. TEXT SIZE: this panel is shown shrunk to 320 px wide, so all text must be LARGE: titles about 40 px tall, descriptions about 32 px tall, prices about 44 px tall in this 1024 px wide image. Use the vertical space for text, not decoration. Row 1 (rarity gray-silver): icon red health potion bottle; title "Poción de vida"; description "«¡Bebe agua!» y !purificar"; price "500". Row 2 (rarity gray-silver): icon a war horn; title "Grito de guerra"; description "Cae un cofre de armas"; price "750". Row 3 (rarity blue): icon a small treasure chest; title "Cofre del tesoro"; description "Mejor suerte, al momento"; price "1.500". Row 4 (rarity purple): icon a cursed purple skull with dark smoke; title "Maldición"; description "Blanco y negro + objeto maldito"; price "2.500". Row 5 (rarity purple): icon a cracked boulder; title "Terremoto"; description "Tiembla y sale un jefe"; price "3.000". Row 6 (rarity orange-legendary): icon a frozen glitched hourglass; title "Lag"; description "La imagen se congela 5 s"; price "5.000". Prices use a dot as thousands separator exactly as written. Leave comfortable margins inside the frame.
